#### 1. spinocerebellar ataxia type 25  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.730)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:23166)

**Proposed mechanism:** PNPT1 (HGNC:23166) —DISRUPTS→ tRNA processing (GO:0006366); PNPT1 (HGNC:23166) —DISRUPTS→ rRNA processing (GO:0042274); tRNA processing (GO:0006366) —LEADS_TO→ Spinocerebellar ataxia (HP:0001283); rRNA processing (GO:0042274) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0002096). Loss-of-function mutations in PNPT1 disrupt both tRNA and rRNA processing, leading to distinct but overlapping neurodevelopmental and neurological phenotypes, including spinocerebellar ataxia and developmental delay.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of loss-of-function variants in PNPT1 with a combined gnomAD allele frequency > 0.1% would falsify the claim that these variants are pathogenic and causative for these rare diseases. _(variant: gnomAD v2.1.1)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of PNPT1 in RNA processing for both MONDO:0013978 and MONDO:0012103 could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting RNA biogenesis or stability for patients with either condition.
